hoaxes.title: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro adds a mode that answers every question as a haiku
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Kimi K3.1 Pro launched on Kimi.ai and its API, with open weights promised by November 4.

hoaxes.title: Clayface tickets come with a tub of modelling clay so fans can sculpt along
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Clayface simply opened in 3,458 theaters and is heading for a $23-25 million weekend.

hoaxes.title: Valve confirms Half-Life 3 will be sold only on a crowbar-shaped USB stick
hoaxes.truth: Made up. A Valve developer only mentioned 'HLX' on stage; Valve has not confirmed a new Half-Life game.

hoaxes.title: Amazon lets Prime members reserve AWS cloud capacity for 2029 with free shipping
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Amazon says AWS capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with a good chunk of 2028 booked.
